reason_and_change: The frozen mechanism capture used 64-token forward chunks with the observation hook enabled. v2 used 16-token chunks without that hook. Transformer attention execution can depend on forward chunk shape. v3 restores the original 64-token chunk size and observation-only hook, then reruns the original strict scalar and top1 parity tolerances. It does not alter the model, quantizer, GDN recurrence, rotation or scoring.
formal_replay_rule: No formal shard can run unless both v3 replay parity and FP output-space parity pass.
